delete.title: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting a page. {{title}} is the page's title.
delete.subpages: First sentence of the dialog's text when the page has pages under it (subpages). {{count}} is how many.
delete.description: The dialog's text: what deleting does. Space is a product noun.
delete.list: Accessible name of the list of subpages deleted with the page.
delete.cancel: Button that closes the delete-page dialog without deleting anything.
delete.action: Destructive button that deletes the page; {{count}} counts the page and its subpages (one form for one page, the other for several).
delete.deleting: The delete button while the page is being deleted.
delete.deleted: Toast after deleting. {{title}} is the page's title.
delete.failed: Error in the delete-page dialog when the page couldn't be deleted and the server gave no reason.
move.title: Title of the dialog that moves a page to another Space. {{title}} is the page's title.
move.description: The dialog's text. Space is a product noun.
move.description-subpages: The dialog's text when the page has pages under it (subpages). {{count}} is how many.
move.none: The dialog's text when the workspace has no other Space the person may move it to.
move.to: Label of the picker of the Space to move to.
move.destination: Accessible name of the picker of the Space to move to.
move.list: Accessible name of the list of subpages moved with the page.
move.cancel: Button that closes the move-page dialog without moving the page.
move.action: Button that moves the page; {{count}} counts the page and its subpages.
move.moving: The move button while the page is being moved.
move.moved: Toast after moving. {{title}} is the page's title, {{space}} the Space's name.
move.save-first: Error when the page's unsaved changes couldn't be saved before the move.
move.failed: Error in the move-page dialog when the page couldn't be moved to the other Space and the server gave no reason.
folder.title: Title of the dialog that makes a new folder of pages.
folder.description: Under the title of the dialog that makes a new folder of pages: what a folder is.
folder.name: Placeholder and accessible name of the folder's name field.
folder.cancel: Button that closes the new-folder dialog without creating a folder.
folder.failed: Error in the new-folder dialog when the folder couldn't be created and the server gave no reason.
